name: RCA DOFSTA oxygen gain, Cabled-10 AT42-12 (2019), Slope Base Shallow Profiler

annotations.annotation: Following the 2019 deployment, the platform experienced a several-day, major blow down event (350 m west, 48 m deep), most likely due to strong currents. The platform and profiler pod were inspected by the Jason ROV, but there was no visual indication of damage or other issue that could have caused the shift in location.

rca:flags.text: The .cnv has no sbox0Mm/Kg column, so shipboard SBE43 oxygen was converted from ml/l to umol/kg with the Sea-Bird formula (ml/l x 44660 / (EOS-80 sigma-theta + 1000)), using sal00, t090C and prDM.
Reference .cnv was processed with datcnv only; alignctd / celltm / loopedit are not applied, which matters for the SBE43 oxygen sensor.
Winkler oxygen is the discrete summary's mL/L value converted to umol/kg with the Sea-Bird formula, using the CTD salinity 1, temperature 1 and pressure at each bottle closure.
Winkler bottles deeper than the profiler's deepest sample (237 m) are not used for the ship-sensor gain: 0 of 6 rows from the summary left out.

OOI annotation 2512 (None; 2019-06-24 19:03:08 to 2019-07-12 10:06:48) covers 25139 of the samples used: Following the 2019 deployment, the platform experienced a several-day, major blow down event (350 m west, 48 m deep), most likely due to strong currents. The platform and profiler pod were inspected by the Jason ROV, but there was no visual indication of damage or other issue that could have caused the shift in location.
